rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something in advance, especially to prepare for a later event.

example.english: We agreed on a meeting place beforehand so we wouldn’t have trouble finding everyone later.
example.traditional: 我哋預早約定咗集合地點，免得到時搵唔到大家。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jyu6 zou2 joek3 ding6 zo2 zaap6 hap6 dei6 dim2 min5 dak1 dou3 si4 wan2 m4 dou3 daai6 gaa1

rows.note: Use this when you mean at a time before a specified event or point, rather than emphasizing advance preparation.

example.english: Had you been to that restaurant beforehand?
example.traditional: 你之前有冇去過嗰間餐廳？
example.jyutping: nei5 zi1 cin4 jau5 mou5 heoi3 gwo3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1
